How to play

  1. Miss Ruby spins the cage and calls one letter at a time. There are 25 balls, one for every square.
  2. Click any empty square on your card to place the letter. Once it is down, it stays.
  3. Build real words reading across and down. Each row and each column scores its longest word.
  4. You never know which letter comes next, so leave yourself room!
3 letters = 34 letters = 65 letters = 12Magic Cross = +20
